components.name: Identities
components.outcome: Confirm who is requesting access and keep account access current.
components.check: Who can sign in? Who has admin access? How do you remove access when someone leaves? Make sure you can regain access in an emergency. Accounts used by apps need different checks from people.

kit.name: People & accounts
kit.sub: Employees, guests and accounts used by apps

items.name: Protect admin sign-in from fake websites
Emergency access if normal sign-in fails
A second sign-in check for everyone
A second sign-in check for guests
Protect how sign-in methods and devices are added
Remove admin access people no longer need
Update access when people join, change roles or leave

components.name: Endpoints
components.outcome: Check whether devices are safe enough to access work information.
components.check: Which devices can access work? Who checks updates and protection? What happens if a device is lost?

kit.name: Devices
kit.sub: Work computers, personal laptops and phones

items.name: Block device types you do not support
Require computers to pass security checks
Use approved apps on mobile devices
Protect stored files if a device is lost

components.name: Access Controls · Policy Engine
components.sub: Every sign-in evaluated and enforced in real time
components.outcome: Decide when to allow access, limit it or block it.
components.check: Which sign-in rules fit your team? Check available Microsoft features and test emergency access before making changes.

kit.name: Access rules
kit.sub: Check access when someone signs in

items.name: Block older, less secure sign-in methods
Block moving a sign-in between devices
Set how long a sign-in lasts
Avoid staying signed in after closing the browser

components.name: Threat Protection
components.outcome: Help keep harmful messages and fake senders away from your team.
components.check: Who looks after email protection? Are messages from your business easy to verify? Who follows up on suspicious messages?

kit.name: Email & message protection
kit.sub: Messages, links, attachments and fake senders

items.name: Protect email and Teams from harmful content
Help stop others pretending to email from your business

components.name: Data
components.outcome: Help people share work information with the right people.
components.check: Which information is sensitive? Who can share it outside your business? Agree those rules before changing file settings.

items.name: Agree which information needs extra protection
Mark files and email by how sensitive they are
Help prevent sensitive information being shared
Block automatic forwarding to outside email addresses

components.name: Applications & AI
components.sub: Cloud apps, AI apps, agents, MCP servers
components.outcome: Know which apps and AI tools can use business information.
components.check: Which apps and AI tools use your business information? Who approves them? What can they see or change? Different tools may need different settings.

kit.name: Apps & AI
kit.sub: Tools connected to your business information

items.name: Approve connected apps and AI tools before use
Keep a list of connected apps and AI tools

components.name: Telemetry · Analytics · Automation
components.sub: Sign-in and activity records, alerts, and who acts on them
components.outcome: See what happened and make sure someone follows up.
components.check: What activity do you record, and for how long? Does your subscription support it? Who receives alerts and follows up?

kit.name: Activity & alerts
kit.sub: Records of what happened and who follows up

items.name: Send alerts for important security events
Assign someone to act on alerts

components.name: Posture & Governance
components.outcome: Give each rule an owner and keep it useful as your business changes.
components.check: Who owns each policy? How are exceptions agreed? When will you check that the rules still fit your business?

kit.name: Owners & reviews
kit.sub: Who looks after the rules and keeps them current

items.name: Assign policy owners and record agreed exceptions
Review the policies every three months

steps.d: 28 policies and 8 practices across eight components. Press play to follow one sign-in.
Identities prove who they are with strong, phishing-resistant MFA.
Endpoints prove they are managed, encrypted and up to date.
Conditional Access weighs identity, device and risk signals, under rules someone owns and reviews.

steps.t: Only then: data, apps and AI
steps.d: Access reaches labelled data and approved apps and AI agents, nothing else.
Sign-ins and activity are logged, and alerts reach a named owner.
